hud.silence_warn: ⚠ silence — the mic does not hear you (pick the device in the tray)
notify.not_recognized: (not recognized — speak closer to the mic)
notify.copied: Window changed — the text is in the clipboard, paste it manually
focus.changed: The window you were dictating into is no longer active. Where should the text go?
notify.wait_cycle: Wait for the current cycle to finish
notify.stop_before_device: Stop recording before changing the device
notify.device_next: The device applies to the next recording
notify.update_latest: You are on the latest version: {ver}
notify.update_found: New release {ver} is available — update from the tray menu
notify.update_installed: VibeForma {ver} installed — restart from the tray menu
notify.update_refused: Update refused: integrity check failed (details in the log)
notify.update_later: New release {ver} — I will update after the current cycle
settings.title: VibeForma settings
settings.note_silence: silence in speech that closes the phrase and inserts the text
settings.autostop: auto-stop on silence (off — stop only by hotkey again)
settings.note_partial: how often the panel refreshes the recognized text while you speak
settings.note_alpha: the slider changes transparency immediately; Save remembers it
settings.autogrow: window grows with text (off — fixed height)
settings.restore: restore the old clipboard 1 s after pasting
settings.confirm_focus: ask where to paste if the window changed during dictation
settings.exclude_history: keep the inserted text out of Windows clipboard history
settings.note_exclude_history: Windows 10+ also keeps it out of cloud sync; on other systems the clipboard manager may still save the text
settings.notify_text: show the dictated text in notifications (off — only the character count)
settings.note_recog: the model recognizes exactly this language — switch in the tray or here
settings.note_ui: shipped: en, ru — drop a JSON file into app/locales to add more
settings.autostart_w: start the service when Windows starts
model.keep: keep the previous model on disk (fast switching back)
models.desc.large-v3: large-v3 — 3.1 GB, top accuracy, slower (≈1.5 s per 12 s phrase on an RTX GPU)
models.desc.large-v3-turbo: large-v3-turbo — 1.6 GB, near large-v3 accuracy, ~2.4× faster (recommended)
models.desc.medium: medium — 1.5 GB, weaker on complex speech, faster than large
models.desc.small: small — 0.5 GB, for weak hardware, lowest accuracy
dlg.phase_busy: A dictation cycle is running — wait for it to finish and try again.
dlg.cache_note: The previous model lives in the shared cache and was kept.
